name: yaps-memory
description: Persistent private memory for Claude, stored as local Markdown you own.
long_description: Yaps Memory turns the private, local Markdown vault managed by the Yaps desktop app into durable memory for Claude. Claude can remember facts, retrieve prior context, search your notes lexically and semantically, keep daily notes, manage tags and backlinks, and recover earlier versions of a note — all on your computer. This extension uploads nothing: it launches the vault connector that ships inside the installed Yaps app and talks to it locally over stdio. It starts read-only; note writes stay off until you enable them in Yaps → Settings → Agent Access. Requires the Yaps desktop app (version 2.3.124 or newer) from https://www.yaps.ai/download with a signed-in account — an active free trial or Yaps Pro both count.

yaps_cli_path.title: Yaps CLI path (advanced)
yaps_cli_path.description: Optional override for the yaps_cli binary bundled inside the Yaps desktop app. Leave empty to let the extension find the installed app automatically.
